description: Release PR bumps the catalog API and order worker image tags (task definitions replaced, services rolled: a routine deploy) and, in the same tfvars edit, sets api_desired_count to 0 "for the weekend". Acceptable: scheduled-job log retention 14 -> 7 days (a retention cut).

material.why: desired_count 6 -> 0 stops every task of the public catalog API: a full outage of the service until someone scales it back up. Hidden inside a routine image-tag deploy of the same service (task_definition also changes).
